mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_ADDITION_ID, ITEM_ID, ADDITION_ITEM_NAME, ADDITION_SALE_PRICE, ADDITION_STOCK_FLAG, ADDITION_STOCK_QUANTITY, ADDITION_STOCK_CODE, ADDITION_TAX_TYPE, ADDITION_WEIGHT, ADDITION_DISPLAY_FLAG, CREATED_DATE FROM OP_ITEM_ADDITION WHERE ITEM_ID = #{value}

SELECT ITEM_ADDITION_ID, ITEM_ID, ADDITION_ITEM_NAME, ADDITION_SALE_PRICE, ADDITION_STOCK_FLAG, ADDITION_STOCK_QUANTITY, ADDITION_STOCK_CODE, ADDITION_TAX_TYPE, ADDITION_WEIGHT, ADDITION_DISPLAY_FLAG, CREATED_DATE FROM OP_ITEM_ADDITION WHERE ITEM_ADDITION_ID = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OP_ITEM_ADDITION (ITEM_ADDITION_ID, ITEM_ID, ADDITION_ITEM_NAME, ADDITION_SALE_PRICE, ADDITION_STOCK_FLAG, ADDITION_STOCK_QUANTITY, ADDITION_STOCK_CODE, ADDITION_TAX_TYPE, ADDITION_WEIGHT, ADDITION_DISPLAY_FLAG, CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{itemAdditionId}, #{itemId}, #{additionItemName}, #{additionSalePrice}, #{additionStockFlag}, #{additionStockQuantity}, #{additionStockCode}, #{additionTaxType}, #{additionWeight}, #{additionDisplayFlag}, )
mapper.update: UPDATE OP_ITEM_ADDITION SET ITEM_ID = #{itemId}, ADDITION_ITEM_NAME = #{additionItemName}, ADDITION_SALE_PRICE = #{additionSalePrice}, ADDITION_STOCK_FLAG = #{additionStockFlag}, ADDITION_STOCK_QUANTITY = #{additionStockQuantity}, ADDITION_STOCK_CODE = #{additionStockCode}, ADDITION_TAX_TYPE = #{additionTaxType}, ADDITION_WEIGHT = #{additionWeight}, ADDITION_DISPLAY_FLAG = #{additionDisplayFlag}, CREATED_DATE = #{createdDate} WHERE ITEM_ADDITION_ID = #{itemAdditionId}
